name: SAYLOR / MSTR — No. 14
description: THOMQU — a silkscreen press wired to a ticker. Michael Saylor (MSTR) rendered as a generative screenprint: posterized ink plates, press misregistration and databend, the day's newspaper baked into the channels. Each work is frozen at its mint-day press state. 14 of 128, limited edition. thomqu.com
